(K V W : Type) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace K V]
  [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace K W] (T : V → W) :
  LinearAlgebraGame.is_linear_map_v K V W T ↔
    (∀ (u v : V), T (u + v) = T u + T v) ∧ ∀ (a : K) (v : V), T (a • v) = a • T v
name: LinearAlgebraGame.linear_map_def
content: A linear map preserves vector addition and scalar multiplication.
